caption:
क्या आप जानते हैं रामायण के सेट पर रणबीर कपूर का क्या हाल होता था?

फिल्म रामायण में भगवान राम का किरदार निभाने के लिए रणबीर कपूर को भारी कॉस्ट्यूम्स और मुकुट पहनना पड़ता था।
अजिंक्य देव, जिन्होंने फिल्म में महर्षि विश्वामित्र का रोल निभाया है, उन्होंने सेट का एक किस्सा शेयर किया है।
अजिंक्य ने बताया कि भारी गेट-अप और मुकुट के कारण रणबीर को काफी परेशानी होती थी और वो थक जाते थे।
हालांकि राहत की बात यह थी कि शूटिंग इंडोर और कंट्रोल तापमान में हुई, जिससे थोड़ी आसानी रही।
अजिंक्य ने खुद के बारे में बताया कि उन्हें साधु के रूप में रहना था, इसलिए भारी कपड़ों से बच गए, लेकिन उनकी दाढ़ी और विग लगाने में डेढ़ घंटा लगता था।
फिल्म में यश रावण के रोल में हैं और यह फिल्म 4000 करोड़ के भारी-भरकम बजट में बनी है। 👑🎬

रणबीर कपूर की इस मेहनत को देखकर आपको क्या लगता है, क्या यह फिल्म बॉक्स ऑफिस पर धमाल मचाएगी? 🧐

ctx.title: Ramayana actor Ajinkya Deo says heavy crown, elaborate costumes posed a challenge for Ranbir Kapoor during shoot
ctx.summary: Ramayana actor Ajinkya Deo says the film’s elaborate costumes posed a challenge for actors, but shooting indoors with controlled temperatures helped.
ctx.text:
Ranbir Kapoor -starrer Ramayana released in theatres on Thursday and opened to rave reviews. Apart from the audience, several celebrities, including Karan Johar and SS Rajamouli, have also praised the film. Ranbir plays Lord Rama, while Yash essays the role of Ravana. For the epic, the actors had to wear elaborate costumes and heavy crowns. In a recent interaction, Ajinkya Deo, who plays Maharishi Vishwamitra, spoke about the elaborate costumes and revealed how Ranbir would get tired wearing his crown.
Speaking to NDTV, Ajinkya shared that since he played Maharishi Vishwamitra, he did not have to wear elaborate costumes. He said, "Most of the time, I was bare-bodied because I was playing a sadhu, Vishwamitra. So that was a good thing. But the hair and the beard that I had to wear were quite heavy. It took one-and-a-half hours just to put on the wig and the beard."
However, Ajinkya admitted that the elaborate costumes were a challenge for several other actors, including Ranbir. Sharing what he observed on the sets, he said, "For the rest of the guys, yes, it was a challenge. I know for a fact that for Ram, it was a little troublesome wearing the crown and the whole get-up. He used to get up and be like, 'Oh my God!' It used to be heavy. The good thing was that everything was indoors and the temperature was controlled, so that was one saving grace."
After the film's release, Alia Bhatt shared behind-the-scenes pictures from its sets, including glimpses of her and Ranbir's daughter, Raha, with the actor. Alia penned a note for Ranbir which read as, "You poured everything into this one and somehow still had all of it left for her ❤️ so proud of you Ranbir and of every single person who brought their heart and soul to this incredible experience at the movies. Some stories are bigger than all of us & Ramayana is one of them."
Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, Ramayana is a two-part cinematic adaptation of the Indian epic. The ensemble cast also includes Sai Pallavi as Sita, Sunny Deol as Hanuman and Ravi Dubey as Lakshman, and Arun Govil, Lara Dutta, Rakul Preet Singh, Kajal Aggarwal and Vivek Oberoi, among others. The two-part epic is made ona budget of ₹ 4000 crore.
